structure.structure_en: Living room, rectangular, wider than deep, 4 m x 3.5 m; ceiling 2.8 m; floor: large-format grey marble-look polished tiles laid in a square grid, continuous glossy floor plane, no steps or level changes. Left open doorway 0.9 x 2.05 m, sill 0 m, 50% along the wall. Front-right floor-to-ceiling sliding glass door 2.2 x 2.5 m, sill 0 m, 55% along the wall. Camera 1.5 m high, 3.5 m to the far wall, 24 mm lens, tilt -2 degrees, horizon 45% of frame height. The number of openings is exactly 2; do not add or remove any opening. Opening proportion: the opening covers about half the wall with solid wall on both sides. Fixed features that stay: ceiling cornice: plain white plaster cornice running along all wall-ceiling junctions; skirting board: white painted skirting, about 90 mm high, along all walls; wall access panel: flush white rectangular cover panel set low into the far wall; sliding door frame: black aluminium frame with two sliding leaves and a fixed transom above.
structure.structure_en_model: The living room is a rectangular shell, wider than deep, with a flat plain white ceiling at about 2.8 m and no beams. Flat painted walls form one continuous plane per side, finished with white plaster cornice above and white skirting below. The floor is a single glossy plane of large-format grey marble-look tiles in a square grid, with no level changes. The far wall carries a low flush access panel. The left wall has an open leafless doorway with a dark threshold leading to a corridor. The right wall is largely glazed by a black-framed floor-to-ceiling sliding door with a fixed transom above, opening onto a railed balcony. The camera sits at 1.5 m in two-point perspective toward the front-right corner.
